Has anything like that ever happened to you? Child. Yeah! I got lost in Asda. No, Tesco. In the big Tesco. Therapist. In the big Tesco. What happened? Child. I went to look at the cakes, the ones with the faces on, and then Mummy wasn't there. Therapist. Mummy wasn't there. Child. My tummy went all funny, like, wobbly. Therapist. Your tummy went all wobbly. What did you do? Child. I was crying. I couldn't see Mummy anywhere. Therapist. You couldn't see her anywhere. Child. And then a lady comed. She had a badge on, a green one. A lady with a green badge. She works there. Me and her goed to the front where the tills are. Therapist. Okay, so the lady took you to the tills. Child. And she said it on the speaker. She said, "Lily is at the front." Everybody heard it. She said your name on the speaker! Therapist. Then what? Child. Mummy came running really fast and gave me a big squeeze. I was happy then. Therapist. And was that the end of the shopping? Child. We still had to get the shopping. And I got one of the face cakes cos I was a good girl. Therapist. You got a face cake! Let me tell you what I heard. You were in the big Tesco and you went to look at the cakes, and then Mummy wasn't there. Your tummy went all wobbly and you were crying, and you couldn't see Mummy anywhere. A lady with a green badge took you to the front by the tills and said your name on the speaker. Then Mummy came running and gave you a big squeeze, and you were happy. And the cake. And you got a face cake. Do you like the face cakes? Child. I've never tried one. Therapist. Which face did you get? Child. A cat face. With pink ears.
